discovery_expectations.text: Tests empty string or whitespace-only values (Number('') is 0, Number('  ') is 0 — coerced to number)
discovery_expectations.evidence: it('returns string for empty string'): getTypedValue('') === ''; it('returns string for whitespace-only string'): getTypedValue('   ') === '   ' — guard prevents coercion

discovery_expectations.text: Tests duplicate keys within same section (last wins silently)
discovery_expectations.evidence: it('overwrites earlier key when same key appears twice in a section'): parseConfig('[s]\nkey = first\nkey = second') — config['s']['key'].raw === 'second'
